script_text: Bienvenidos a esta clase sobre ProjectManage 11 ProjectManage Billing en SAP Business One. En esta lección exploraremos las mejores prácticas de consultoría, flujos operativos y configuraciones del sistema. Project Management: Billing Version SAP Busi10.0ness One Welcome to the Project Management – Billing course. In order to understand this course, you need to be familiar with the Project Management module as described in the Project Management course.

At the end of this topic, you will be able to: Add time sheet records Define documents, activities and time sheet records as chargeable Run the Billing Document Generation Wizard 2 INTERNAL At the end of this topic, you will be able to: Add time sheet records Define documents, activities and time sheet records as chargeable Run the Billing Document Generation Wizard Objectives

INTERNAL Business Scenario OEC Computers provides technical IT solutions for their customers. They use the Project Management module to manage complicated projects. In these projects they bill their customers for working hours, purchased components, assembly of devices and so on. Today, they issue invoices manually. In addition, the company sends technicians to do various tasks on customers sites, and they would like to document these hours to bill them accordingly. To achieve this, OEC computers decides to use the Billing Document Generation Wizard to create invoices for multiple billable components related to a project. INTERNAL Billing Document Generation Wizard Concept HR Time Sheet Project Master Data billable data: A P invoices A R quotations orders deliveries Work Orders (production orders) Activities (CRM) Billing Document Generation Wizard Run A R Invoice A R Delivery Output Process Sources The Billing Document Generation wizard is available starting from version 9.3. This wizard collects open documents and billable project information. The wizard processes this data and generates an A R invoice or a delivery. The sources for the wizard can be: A P invoices that were issued as expenses of the project, A R quotations, orders or deliveries that were already issued to the project’s customer and can be copied to a delivery or an invoices. Closed work orders for items produced for the project. Activities for meetings, calls and tasks that were made in this project.

INTERNAL Marking Source Data as Chargeable A R+A P documents Work Orders Chargeable √ In the Project Master Data Time Sheet Activities (CRM) In the Activity Type window Chargeable √ Connect the Activity Type Different ways to mark different data as chargeable The Billing Document Generation wizard only collects records that are marked as Chargeable. In the Project Master Data, in the lower data matrix, you can check the Chargeable box for marketing document and work order rows. Activities and time sheet records are marked as chargeable in a different way. First you define Activity Types. For each Activity Type record, you define whether it is chargeable or not. Then, you connect a chargeable Activity Type to a Time Sheet record or to an Activity (CRM). You will learn how to set this up in the next slides.

INTERNAL Marking Document Rows as Chargeable in the Project Master Data In the Project Master Data: Work Orders as marked as changeable the same way. In order to include marketing documents and work orders from the project in the billing process, you need to mark them as Chargeable. In the image you can see two A P invoices that are marked as chargeable. Note that work orders are marked the same way in the Project Master Data.

No. 10 Date To 30.11. Filtering date range The Time Sheet is a HR object in SAP Business One. It is used to record durations of different activities made by an employee, a user or another entity. It can also be used to record employees’ attendance manually. There is one time sheet record for each employee user. The records are filtered according to the time range entered in the header. For each employee or user, create a time sheet. You can continue to add rows for each time an employee works on a project. In each row, you specify the date and the activity for the work performed. A time sheet report can be generated directly from the Project Master Data. Right click the project’s header to receive a report filtered by the project sub project. Right click a stage to receive a report filtered for this stage. In OEC Computers, employees record the time they spend on the customer site or when doing other back office tasks related to a certain project. For each record, a certain Activity Type is chosen. An Activity Type is either chargeable or not. A time sheet record that is connected to a chargeable activity and connected to a project stage, will be included in the billing wizard. Activity types are predefined separately – let us see how in the next slide.

INTERNAL Activity Type Administration Setup > Project Management > Activity Types Using the Activity Type, Time Sheet records and Activities (CRM) can be marked as chargeable Activity Type End Time Start Time Date Consulting 13:00 08:00 27.11. 1 2 Time Sheet First of all note that the Activity Type and the Activity (meeting, call etc.) are two different objects. While the first one is a definition related to project management, the second one is a CRM object. However they can be connected as explained in the next slide. In the Activity Type – Setup window define the different activity types you want to record. An Activity Type can be checked as chargeable. Then, Time Sheet records and Activities (CRM), that are connected to a chargeable Activity Type, will be included in the Billing Document Generation Wizard run. Note that you can define an Activity Type as absence. Then choose this activity type to record absence in the Time Sheet. In OEC Computers, Kate, the project manager, enters the Activity Types Setup window and adds a new activity type, named Consulting. She connects it to labor item L10001 – hourly charge. This is the item that will be invoiced in the A R document that the wizard will generate. Then Kate marks the activity type as chargeable. When she adds records to the Time Sheet, she uses this Activity Type for recording consulting hours.

INTERNAL Activity as a Billable Object From the CRM module: The same Activity Type is used in the Activity (CRM) that was added for a steering teem meeting on the customer site. This activity will be included in the Billing Document Generation Wizard since: The activity is connected to a project stage. In this example it is (12 1) A chargeable Activity Type is connected and The same financial project code is connected to the Activity and the project master data.

INTERNAL Billing Document Generation Wizard – Source and Target Information From: Project Management > Billing Document Generation Or via the context menu of the Project Master Data Source Information Target Information The wizard collects open documents and billable items that are connected to a project and then generates an A R Invoice or a Delivery. In the target information choose the type of document to generate, the relevant project and the target stage to which the generated document will be connected. The chosen project is also the source project from which all source data is extracted. In the Source Types section choose what to include in the run. Note that the wizard not only generates A R documents based on A P invoices (expenses documented in the project), but also A R documents based on Sales Quotation Orders or Deliveries that are connected to the project. For example, when a sales order is connected to one of the stages in the project, and you checked the Include Open A R Documents for Sales Orders, then the wizard will generate a delivery or an A R invoice based on this order. Note that A R document rows, in the Project Master Data should also be marked as Chargeable to be included in the wizard run. In the Source Types you can also choose to include work orders, time sheet records and activities. All source types refer to objects that are connected to the project in subject. When Kate runs the wizard, she highlights the target stage row in the project and then chooses the Billing Document Generation Wizard from the context menu. Then, when the wizard opens, the stage code is updated automatically in the Stage field.

INTERNAL Billing Document Generation Wizard – Confirm and Execute In step 2 confirm each relevant source Confirmed √ Finish Choose Finish to open the document created by the wizard Add Add the automatically created A R Invoice or Delivery In step 2, the wizard displays the list of sources that are connected to the project. The system recommends only resources with the same financial project code. In the second stage you can still edit the activity type, quantity and delivery date. Then confirm the sources to include. To generate the document choose Finish. The target document opens automatically in Add mode. You can still make any change in the document and then add it. Once the document is added, it is connect to the target stage of the project. It is also already marked as chargeable and it is not editable anymore. Note that the items involved in the automatically created document are driven from the source objects. For marketing documents, the items are copied from the base documents. The same applies for work orders. For time sheet and activity records, the items are taken from the activity type associated with these records.

INTERNAL Summary Here are some key points: The Billing Document Generation Wizard generates an A R invoice or a delivery per one project. The billable source objects in the project are: A P invoices, work orders, time sheet records and activities. A R sales quotations, orders and deliveries can also be included in the wizard run. In this case the system generates a delivery or an invoice based on these documents. Time sheet records are not recorded in the project master data. However, a connection to the project is done in the time sheet, in the Stage field. Each source object has to be marked as Chargeable. For marketing documents and work orders, it is marked in the rows of the project master data. For time sheet records and activities Chargeable is marked in the Activity Type that is connected to the object.
